summary: American Honda Receivables LLC, as depositor for Honda Auto Receivables 2026-4 Owner Trust, filed an 8-K reporting a November 3, 2026 underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan, Deutsche Bank, ING and TD Securities for five classes of auto-loan asset-backed notes totaling $2,105,270,000 in initial principal: Class A-1 at 4.303%, A-2a at 4.72%, A-2b at SOFR plus 0.36%, A-3 at 5.02% and A-4 at 5.11%. Closing is expected on or about November 12, 2026, with AHFC retaining at least 5% of each class to satisfy risk-retention rules. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation; watch spread pricing and receivables performance.
